column5: F: Where does it start? | M: A fresh model, nothing typed.
column6: F: Where does this start? | M: With a fresh model of a building, 6458 elements. The project, its 7 phases, 27 tasks and 67 lines are computed, then pushed. All 440 rows read back the same.

column5: F: First, the money? | M: The approved budget.
column6: F: What does the CFO see first? | M: The approved budget, just over ninety-one million taka. Currencies are never added together.

column5: F: And what is spent? | M: Fifteen taka and thirty.
column6: F: And what is spent so far? | M: Fifteen taka thirty. Two real material issues, completed in iDempiere, so next to nothing against that budget.

column5: F: Committed cost? | M: Contract has no data, honestly.
column6: F: And committed? | M: Two lines, both ours, labelled proposed. Contract says no data: no completed purchase orders. Verified is fifteen thirty, and overlaps the actual cost.

column5: F: And where does it end up? | M: The forecast, 24.81.
column6: F: Where does it end up? | M: The forecast is 24.81. Spent plus what is left, divided by cost performance. It is proposed, labelled so, until the client confirms.

column5: F: Now the project manager. | M: Within budget.
column6: F: Now the project manager's view? | M: Budget status: within budget. No overrun, so the overrun says no data, not zero.

column5: F: Is it healthy? | M: Not enough data yet.
column6: F: Is the project healthy? | M: It says no data. No phase has reached its end date yet, so health has nothing to judge. It does not guess a colour.

column5: F: On time? | M: Yes, one on time.
column6: F: And the schedule? | M: One project on time, none delayed, and the average delay has no data.

column5: F: How much is built? | M: Sixty-two percent, spent nothing.
column6: F: How much is physically done? | M: Three phases ticked complete, about sixty-two percent. Spent is zero. They disagree, and that is the point.

column5: F: Which stage? | M: Not set yet.
column6: F: Which stage is it in? | M: No stage. The five CAPEX stages exist as data, proposed, but nobody has set this project's stage.

column5: F: And one project? | M: Pick it here.
column6: F: Can I look at one project? | M: Pick it here. Blank is all projects, and the list only offers projects the other filters allow.

column5: F: Drawings issued? | M: None filed yet.
column6: F: And the drawings? | M: The document tile counts deliverables issued for construction. None are filed, so it says no data.

column6: F: Can I change what counts? | M: A goal's target is edited on the Home tab, and the dial recomputes. Every definition here is a data row, not code.

column5: F: How is it installed? | M: As data, granted first.
column6: F: And how does it get installed? | M: As a data pack on the twin and migration scripts on iDempiere. Three definitions are ours, awaiting the client.
